# Regionshospital Nordjylland

Regionshospital Nordjylland is a Danish regional hospital that participates in the DANIBD registry, a comprehensive database of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatment and outcomes across Danish healthcare institutions. As of the October 2023 to September 2024 reporting period, the hospital was treating 138 patients receiving biologic therapy (BMSL — biologisk lægemiddelbehandling) for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1]. Of these patients, 84 (61%) had Crohn's disease and 54 (39%) had ulcerative colitis [^src1].

The hospital's patient cohort reflects broader patterns in IBD management documented in the DANIBD registry, which tracks treatment patterns, surgical interventions, and comorbidities such as primary sclerosing cholangitis (PSC) across Danish adult and pediatric IBD populations [^src1]. Regionshospital Nordjylland's participation in this registry provides granular data on biologic drug treatment efficacy and patient demographics in the North Jutland region of Denmark.
